description: This file declares functions related to the RDK EasyMesh Controller's data model interactions with RBUS, including initialization, cleanup, and data retrieval for ALE and radio information.

methods.name: map_dm_rbus_get_ale
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to ALE information based on the provided index.

methods.name: map_dm_rbus_get_radio
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to radio information for a given ALE and radio index.

methods.name: map_dm_rbus_init
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS interface for the RDK EasyMesh data model.

methods.name: map_dm_rbus_fini
methods.description: Performs cleanup of the RBUS interface for the data model.
